nodes.description: OER performance in 1.0 M KOH electrolyte
nodes.source_text: at current densities of 100, 300, and 500 mA cm-2, the ratios for Ni2@IF/60-5 are 83.3%, 61.6%, and 50.5% in 1 M KOH... overpotentials of Ni2@IF/60-5 without iR compensation were found to be 754... 381 mV (after).

nodes.description: OER performance comparison in 1M vs 6M KOH
nodes.source_text: Notably, for Fe1.5@NF/60-5, the overpotential difference in 1 M KOH is 4.42 times higher than in 6 M KOH... the differential overpotential coefficient increased from 0.383 to 1.693 Ω cm2, which was expanded by a factor of 4.4 when the electrolyte concentration was reduced from 6 to 1 M.
Specifically, for Fe1.5@NF/60-5... the ODC generated in 1 M KOH (1.693 Ω cm2) is 4.42 times that in 6 M KOH (0.383 Ω cm2).

nodes.characterization_summary: EIS was used to measure solution resistance (Rs) and interfacial transfer resistance (Rct) in 1, 3, and 6 M KOH for all catalysts. In 1 M KOH, Rs was ~1.0 Ohm for all samples, while Rct varied significantly, reaching 8.537 Ohm for Fe1.5@NF/60-5.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Table. 1 lists the values of solution resistance Rs and interfacial transfer resistance Rct measured before the iR compensation test ... Rs about 1Ω under 1M KOH, Rs about 0.7Ω under 3M KOH, and Rs about 0.6Ω for 6M KOH.
